title: Ruy Lopez: Marshall Attack
line: Black gives a pawn to send its pieces at the white king.

steps.text: The main line of the Ruy Lopez.
Both sides castle, and Black chases the bishop back.
Move the pawn on c2 one square, to give the bishop a way back.

also.h2h3: That move avoids what comes next. This lesson lets Black play it.
also.a2a4: That move avoids what comes next. This lesson lets Black play it.

steps.after: This is the Marshall Attack: Black offers the pawn on d5.

steps.text: Take the pawn Black offers. The main line accepts it.
Take the pawn on e5 with the knight. If the knights trade, your rook takes back.
Take back with the rook. You are a pawn up, and the rook is active.
steps.after: Black does not take the pawn back. Its pieces get ready to go after your king, while yours on the queen side are still at home.

steps.text: Push the pawn in front of your queen two squares. It frees your bishop on c1.

also.e5e1: Moving the rook back at once is also played. This lesson pushes the pawn first.

steps.text: The bishop attacks your rook. Step it back home.
The queen and the bishop both aim at h2. Push the pawn on g2 one square to block the bishop and chase the queen.

wrong.h2h3: The bishop takes on h3. If the pawn takes back, the queen takes it too and comes at your king.

steps.after: You are a pawn up, but Black's queen sits near your king. That is the fight of the Marshall.

summary: Black gives a pawn for an attack. White takes it, defends with care, and gets the queen side pieces out.
